B4.1.2.2 requires describing and applying mental mathematics strategies and number properties for basic multiplication facts to 81 and the related division facts, i.e. fact-level fluency and structural understanding of division. B4.1.2.5 requires demonstrating an understanding of division of a 2- or 3-digit number by a one-digit number, which operates on those same basic division facts within a longer multi-digit procedure. The second SFI (B5.3.2.2.1, 'Select and justify referents for cm3 or m3 units', LCs 'select referents for cm3 or m3 units' / 'justify referents...') establishes a concrete sense of what a cubic-centimetre/cubic-metre unit is; the first SFI (B5.3.3.2.2, 'Determine the volume of boxes by finding how many cubes of sizes 1cm3 each contains') applies that unit understanding to iterate and count 1cm³ units to quantify a box's volume. Proficiency with volume-unit referents substantively supports success in unit-cube counting, justifying same-rank direction second_to_first rather than mere shared-topic overlap; shared 'volume'/'cm3' tokens, page adjacency and code prefix alone were not treated as evidence. Endpoint audit/merge context (including the B5.3.2.2 same-code/different-content flag on the shared parent and truncated source evidence) tempers confidence but does not contradict the content read.
